kebab_example: aliyun ens run-service-schedule --app-id 474bdef0-d149-4695-abfb-52912d9143f0 --uuid hdm_d4f1059a8e1afc0956bd71b497faa433 --client-ip 180.166.45.146 --service-action Start --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunServiceSchedule

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the client
parameters.name: client_ip

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling operation. The value must be of the enumeration type. Valid values:

Container scenario:

Start: selects and activates an idle cloud device.

Stop: stops and releases the cloud device.

Console: performs the scheduling operation when the device is in the scheduling state.

Bare metal instance or virtual machine scenario:

PreSchedule: locks a virtual machine instance for scheduling.

Confirm: confirms the scheduling operation.

Cancel: cancels the scheduling operation.

Console: performs the scheduling operation when the device is in the scheduling state
parameters.help_zh:
调度服务操作。枚举类型，取值范围：

容器化场景：

Start：选择并激活一个可调度云设备，启动服务
Stop：结束并释放云设备
Console：Uuid处于调度中状态时，进行命令交互

裸金属/虚机场景：
  
PreSchedule：预调度并锁定虚机实例
Confirm：确认调度
Cancel：取消调度
Console：Uuid处于调度中状态时，进行命令交互
parameters.name: service_action

parameters.help_en: The parameter does not take effect
parameters.name: pod_config_name

parameters.help_en: The maximum duration for locking an idle device. Unit: seconds. This parameter takes effect only if you set ServiceAction to PreSchedule. Default value: 300
parameters.help_zh: 锁定空闲设备的时间上限，单位秒，仅ServiceAction=PreSchedule有效。默认300
parameters.name: pre_locked_timeout

parameters.help_en: The directory to which the data file is mounted. The value must be a full path and cannot be '/../'. Example: ["/data/app01", "/data/user"]. Specify the relative path of the virtual device for this parameter. For example, specify /data for this parameter when the actual path of the virtual device is /data/{input path}
parameters.help_zh:
需要挂载的用户数据文件的目录列表。必须是全路径，不支持'/../'，取值示例： ["/data/app01", "/data/user"]。
注意：输入的目录路径是虚拟设备"/data"目录的相对目录，即实际对应的虚拟设备路径为"/data/{输入路径}"
parameters.name: directorys

parameters.help_en: The service commands. The value must be a JSON string
parameters.help_zh: 容器服务命令列表。Json数组格式的字符串
parameters.name: service_commands

parameters.help_en: The scheduling policy of the device. The value must be a JSON string
parameters.help_zh: 设备调度策略。Json格式的字符串
parameters.name: schedule_strategy

Index.description_en: The index number of the scheduled virtual device (pod)
Index.description_zh: 调度的目标虚拟设备（容器Pod）索引号

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the scheduled instance

InstanceIp.description_en: The IP address of the scheduled instance

InstancePort.description_en: The start port of the scheduled instance
InstancePort.description_zh: 调度的目标实例Port起始端口

RequestRepeated.description_en: Indicates whether the request is repeated. This parameter is not returned if ServcieAction is set to Console

TcpPorts.description_en: The TCP port range of the scheduled instance or container. The value is in the ${from}-$-{to} format. Example: 80-88
TcpPorts.description_zh: 调度的目标虚机实例/容器的tcp服务端口范围，取值格式：${from}-${to}，如80-88
